using System;
using System.IO;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _pathsMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbContextFactoryMock;
        private readonly Mock<IXmlSerializer> _xmlSerializerMock;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
            _pathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _dbContextFactoryMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _xmlSerializerMock = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingUserDatabase_ThrowsIOException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = "/test/data";
            var dbFilename = "users.db";
            var userDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename);
            
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
            
            // Create test files
            var tempDbPath = Path.GetTempFileName();
            var tempJournalPath = Path.GetTempFileName();
            File.Move(tempDbPath, Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), dbFilename)); // Ensure file exists initially
            try
            {
                // Simulate the file move scenario by making target path read-only or use invalid path
                var targetPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename + ".old");
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(targetPath)!);
                
                _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
                
                var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                    _loggerMock.Object,
                    _pathsMock.Object,
                    _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                    _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

                // Make the target directory/path cause IOException (use invalid path for testing)
                _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("C:\\invalid\\path\\for\\testing"); // Invalid path will cause IOException

                // Act
                migrateUserDb.Perform();
            }
            catch
            {
                // The IOException is expected and caught internally
            }

            // Assert - Verify LogError was called with expected message
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<IOException>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAny<string>[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0] == "Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'")),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("/test/data");

            var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _pathsMock.Object,
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

            // Act
            migrateUserDb.Perform();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _pathsMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbContextFactoryMock;
        private readonly Mock<IXmlSerializer> _xmlSerializerMock;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
            _pathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _dbContextFactoryMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _xmlSerializerMock = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingUserDatabase_ThrowsIOException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "jellyfin-test-data");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
            
            var dbFilename = "users.db";
            var userDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename);
            
            // Create the database file so migration proceeds to file rename
            File.WriteAllText(userDbPath, "test");
            
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.UserConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns(dataPath);
            
            // Mock dependencies to avoid actual DB operations
            _xmlSerializerMock.Setup(x => x.DeserializeFromFile(It.IsAny<Type>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(new object());
            
            _dbContextFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).Returns(Mock.Of<DbContext>());
            
            var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _pathsMock.Object,
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

            // Act - IOException will be thrown by File.Move due to making target file read-only or other conflict
            // Make the target path cause IOException by creating it as read-only
            var targetPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename + ".old");
            File.WriteAllText(targetPath, "locked");
            File.SetAttributes(targetPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);

            migrateUserDb.Perform();

            // Assert - Verify LogError was called with expected message
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    "Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarningAndReturns()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = Path.GetTempPath();
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

            var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _pathsMock.Object,
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

            // Act
            migrateUserDb.Perform();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogWarning(
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("{UserDbPath} doesn't exist")),

using System;
using System.IO;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _pathsMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbContextFactoryMock;
        private readonly Mock<IXmlSerializer> _xmlSerializerMock;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
            _pathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _dbContextFactoryMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _xmlSerializerMock = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingUserDatabase_ThrowsIOException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "jellyfin-test-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
            
            try
            {
                var dbFilename = "users.db";
                var userDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename);
                File.WriteAllText(userDbPath, "test content"); // Create DB file so migration proceeds
                
                _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
                _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.UserConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns(dataPath);
                
                // Mock to skip heavy migration logic and reach file rename
                _xmlSerializerMock.Setup(x => x.DeserializeFromFile(It.IsAny<Type>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                    .Returns(new object());
                
                var dbContextMock = new Mock<DbContext>();
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).Returns(dbContextMock.Object);
                
                var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                    _loggerMock.Object,
                    _pathsMock.Object,
                    _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                    _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

                // Create read-only target file to force IOException
                var targetPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename + ".old");
                File.WriteAllText(targetPath, "locked");
                File.SetAttributes(targetPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);

                // Act
                migrateUserDb.Perform();

                // Assert - Verify LogError was called with expected message
                _loggerMock.Verify(
                    logger => logger.LogError(
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        "Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'"),
                    Times.Once);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                try { Directory.Delete(dataPath, true); } catch { }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = Path.GetTempPath();
            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

            var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _pathsMock.Object,
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

            // Act
            migrateUserDb.Perform();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogWarning(
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("doesn't exist, nothing to migrate")),
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0] is string path)),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenTableDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange - Setup to pass file existence check but fail table check
            var dataPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "jellyfin-test-table-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
            var userDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, "users.db");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
            File.WriteAllText(userDbPath, "empty db");

            _pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

            var migrateUserDb = new MigrateUserDb(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _pathsMock.Object,
                _dbContextFactoryMock.Object,
                _xmlSerializerMock.Object);

            // Act
            migrateUserDb.Perform();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogWarning(
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Table 'LocalUsersv2' doesn't exist")),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
